title: Affordable Totems
description: Affordable Totems adds a balanced alternative to the Totem of Undying without replacing its role in the game.
body:
# **Affordable Totems**

Affordable Totems adds a balanced alternative to the Totem of Undying without replacing its role in the game.

The Iron Totem can be crafted and is easier to obtain, providing a reliable second chance in difficult situations. It also works directly from your inventory, so it does not need to be held in the player’s hand.

The mod focuses on improving survivability while keeping progression intact. The vanilla Totem of Undying remains stronger and more rewarding to obtain.


# Features

1. Iron Totem

>  Craftable survival item
-  Activates on death like a totem
> Works from inventory, not just hand or offhand
> Designed to be weaker than the vanilla Totem of Undying

# Effects

> Grants Regeneration, Absorption, Slowness, and Fire Resistance
> Effect durations stack when multiple totems activate
> Stacking is capped to maintain balance

# Visuals

Custom activation animation using the Iron Totem
Custom particle effects using iron and emerald colors
Designed to feel consistent with vanilla visuals

### 3D Model Support

Optional 3D model for the Iron Totem

Can be toggled with a command:


/affordabletotems 3dmodel on
/affordabletotems 3dmodel off

Can also be toggled in-game:
ESC → Mods → Affordable Totems → Config

## General

Lightweight and modpack-friendly
Does not modify mobs, world generation, or progression systems



This mod is intended as a middle ground:

Easier to access than the vanilla totem
Useful in high-difficulty or modded environments
Still weaker than the Totem of Undying
It provides an alternative without removing the value of the original item.

Required on both sides. 
Will be updating this project later to fabric.
